# ABC a bollywood company

> Indian dance company in Ghent, Belgium, led by Swapnil Dagliya. Bollywood, Garba,
> Bhangra, Kalbeliya, Lavani and Indian semi-classical dance: performances, workshops,
> weekly classes, online coaching, and the annual Gent India Dans Festival (GIDF).
> Home studio: Shoonya Dance Centre, Stapelplein 41, 9000 Gent. Contact: info@shoonyadance.com.

## Key pages
- Book ABC for your event (performances, workshops, party formats): https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/book/
- Learn to dance (classes in Ghent, online course, workshops across Europe): https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/learn/
- What's on (full agenda of upcoming events + archive): https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/whats-on/
- Gent India Dans Festival: https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/festival/
- About the company & blog: https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/about/
- Free 10-lesson Bollywood course: https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/learn-to-dance-bollywood/
- Contact / booking: https://www.abcbollywoodbelgium.com/contact/
